subject: zoology_2
question_text: List out any two Indian carps and two exotic carps.

verification.note: Sourced from 'My Baby Bullet-Q — Senior Inter Zoology' (Star-Q Pass Track Series, Sri Publishers, 2022), book p.59, VSAQ 131. The printed exam years are the book's claim, reproduced here as appearances. Zoology-II holds only ONE source book in the corpus, so the two-book union check is structurally impossible for this card; 'not checked' does NOT mean 'checked and clean'. The mark split is our reading of the question and is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Indian carps
steps.why: These species are native to the region's rivers, which is why they are called Indian carps.
common_mistakes: Giving only one name in a group.
steps.memory_tip: Catla and rohu are the Indian pair.
lines: Indian carps: Catla catla and Labeo rohita.

steps.label: Exotic carps
steps.why: Exotic means brought in from elsewhere, and these two were introduced to raise pond yields.
common_mistakes: Naming an Indian carp as exotic.
steps.memory_tip: Grass carp and silver carp are the exotic pair.

lines.text: Exotic carps: grass carp and silver carp

insider_note: Four names in two groups. Write them under two headings so the examiner can see both halves.
